painpoints.text: First `sd ready --limit 200` failed with exit 1: mise refused the untrusted config at `/repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml` (bun shim resolves through mise, so the bun-script `sd` CLI dies before running). Workaround: `mise trust /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml`, then sd works. This burned several tool calls at session start; already tracked as seed fabro-66db (sandbox: pre-trust the repo mise config), so no new seed filed — but the painpoint reproduces in planner sessions too, not just implementer ones.

observations: fabro-1e9f ('Diff evidence against the last seed boundary, not the run base') looks ALREADY IMPLEMENTED in the current tree: `evidence.nu` has `seed-claim-base` and `diff-section` anchored at the per-seed claim commit, exactly what its title describes — next planner should treat it as a verification-only candidate rather than fresh work.

Resolved a scope contradiction in fabro-4b57: the seed names only `evidence.nu`, but that script's header declares its output sections a contract with the reviewer prompt ('change wording there too'); the brief therefore includes the `reviewer.md` section-enumeration update to avoid reviewer ping-pong.

Scenario-testing evidence.nu outside the real repo requires `.seeds/config.yaml` on disk — `sd list` errors with 'Not in a seeds project' from a bare issues.jsonl, which makes the script's `in-progress-seed` pipeline fail wholesale; copying the real config into the scratch repo fixed it (file: `.fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu`, in-progress-seed).

The original diff-section appends each file to `included` BEFORE the empty-text check (and once more after the cap check) — membership semantics, not sloppiness: dropping the early append would disclose hunk-less files as cap-omitted. The refactor preserves it; recorded as mx-40abdb so future edits don't 'clean it up'.

painpoints.text: The -U3 diff of evidence.nu itself left the $included-append placement in diff-walk ambiguous (the removed line after $parts-append vs the unchanged region between hunks), forcing a read of the live file to confirm the empty-diff-skip invariant (run 01M1S5MWDTFSQBZ833Q74AGPXB, fabro-4b57). Suggestion: when a refactor moves a small bookkeeping line into shared context, a one-line note in the implementation summary naming the final placement would save reviewers the file detour.

observations: .seeds/issues.jsonl appears in churn counts but not in the loop-work diff — correctly, because its +1/-1 happened in the planner commit (claim base 74bfb5e1) so its per-seed diff is empty and the walk skips it silently; not missing evidence.

Scenario (b) (mixed seed-work+churn leaves output unchanged) was not directly evidenced, but the main() gate is a single side-effect-free conditional returning "" — verified by inspection rather than run.
